name: Databricks
description: Sign in to Databricks once for every Databricks plugin, see live status for Databricks links in conversations, and open dashboards beside the conversation.

args:
set -eu
command -v curl >/dev/null || { echo "curl is required" >&2; exit 2; }
os=$(uname -s | tr A-Z a-z)
case $(uname -m) in x86_64|amd64) a=amd64;; arm64|aarch64) a=arm64;; *) echo "Unsupported CPU $(uname -m)" >&2; exit 2;; esac
t=$(curl -fsSLI -o /dev/null -w '%{url_effective}' https://github.com/databricks/cli/releases/latest); v=${t##*/v}
f=databricks_cli_${v}_${os}_$a.tar.gz; u=https://github.com/databricks/cli/releases/download/v$v
d=$(mktemp -d); trap 'rm -rf "$d"' EXIT; cd "$d"
curl -fsSLO "$u/$f"; curl -fsSL "$u/databricks_cli_${v}_SHA256SUMS" | grep " $f\$" > sums
if command -v sha256sum >/dev/null; then sha256sum -c sums; else shasum -a 256 -c sums; fi
tar -xzf "$f" databricks; mkdir -p "$HOME/.local/bin"; mv -f databricks "$HOME/.local/bin/databricks"
"$HOME/.local/bin/databricks" --version
